    The year 2026 is a common year starting on Thursday of the Gregorian calendar, expected to be a major year for global sports, space exploration, and US history, including the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence. Key events include the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America, the Artemis II lunar mission, and the Winter Olympics in Italy. 
    This video explains how you can plan for a successful year in 2026:

    Key 2026 Events & Highlights 
    • Sports: The 2026 FIFA World Cup will be hosted by the US, Canada, and Mexico (June–July), featuring 48 teams
      . Italy will host the Winter Olympics and Paralympics.
    • Space & Science: NASA's Artemis II is planned for April 2026, marking the first crewed deep-space mission since 1972. A total solar eclipse will occur on August 12, 2026, visible over16 Greenland, Iceland, and Spain.
    • US Milestones: July 4, 2026, marks the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence.
    • Economics: Some predictions suggest 2026 could be a significant year for financial markets, potentially following interest rate adjustments.
    • Calendar: The year starts on a Thursday. It is the year of the Fire Horse in the Chinese zodiac, representing high energy. 
    Predictions & Themes 
    • Systemic Shifts: Observers suggest 2026 will be shaped by intense geopolitical and technological pressures, where automation and digital life significantly impact daily routines.
    • Market Outlook: Some analysts frame 2026 as a major "battlefield" for investment, expecting the 2025 landscape to set up significant changes in 2026.
    • Planning: Experts advise using structured goal-setting, such as 90-day planning cycles, to maximize personal success in 2026. 
    Public Holidays (US) 
    • New Year's Day: January 1
    • Independence Day: July 3 (Observed)
    • Thanksgiving: November 26
    • Christmas: December 25
